question: Which of the following team events is included in the Target Olympic Podium Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) is an initiative by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• It aims to support Indian athletes who have the potential to win Olympic medals.
 
• Hockey is one of the team events included under the TOPS scheme.
 
• The scheme provides financial assistance and other support to athletes, including training, coaching, and international competition exposure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**

 
 
• The scheme was launched in 2014 to provide support to India's top athletes in their preparation for the Olympics and other major international events.
 
• TOPS aims to identify athletes who have the potential to win medals at the Olympics and provide them with customized training and support.
 
• Under the scheme, athletes receive financial assistance for training, equipment, and participation in international competitions.
 
• The scheme also focuses on the holistic development of athletes, including aspects such as sports science support, psychological counseling, and nutrition.
 
 
 
• **Hockey in India**
 
 
• Hockey is one of the most popular sports in India and has a rich history of success in international competitions.
 
• India's men's hockey team has won eight Olympic gold medals, making it one of the most successful teams in the history of the Olympics.
 
• The Indian women's hockey team has also made significant progress in recent years, achieving notable performances in international tournaments.
 
• The inclusion of hockey in the TOPS scheme aims to further strengthen the performance of Indian hockey teams at the international level.
